lines.text: A good name is better than fine perfume, and death is the end of every man.
Sorrow is better than laughter, and the heart of the wise is in the house of feasting.
It is better to heed a wise man's rebuke than the song of fools, and a bribe corrupts the heart.
A patient spirit is better than a proud one, and anger settles in the lap of a king.
Wisdom, like money, is a shelter, and it preserves the life of its owner.
